definitions.explanation: Something that causes negative effects or damage to people, things, or situations.

examples.japanese: {体|からだ}に{害|がい}のある{食|た}べ{物|もの}。
examples.english: Food that is harmful to the body.

examples.japanese: タバコは{健康|けんこう}に{害|がい}がある。
examples.notes: Common construction: Xに{害|がい}がある

examples.japanese: {害|がい}を{与|あた}えないでください。

notes:
{害|がい} means harm, damage, or negative effect.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Xに{害|がい}がある (to be harmful to X)
- {害|がい}を{与|あた}える (to cause harm)
- {害|がい}を{受|う}ける (to receive harm, to be harmed)
- {害|がい}になる (to become harmful)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {害虫|がいちゅう} (pest, harmful insect)
- {公害|こうがい} (pollution)
- {被害|ひがい} (damage, harm suffered)
- {損害|そんがい} (damage, loss)
- {有害|ゆうがい} (harmful)
- {無害|むがい} (harmless)

ANTONYM:
- {益|えき} (benefit)
